blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.
blocks.zh: 计算成像仪(CT)的人工智能系统基本上仍限于特定的解剖区域、检查类型或预先确定的异常情况,限制了它们提供全面和基于空间的解释的能力。 我们在此介绍FORA,一种通用的CT模型,该模型承认并空间定位了1,028个按等级排列的放射性概念,并生成我们集团所代表的28个CT协议的报告。 FORA在304 962次常规CT考试中接受了培训,由他们的报告监督,FORA学会将异常情况本地化而无需手动说明损伤. 其架构结合了多层学习与可解释的概念瓶颈,将空间证据,放射性发现和报告生成联系起来. 我们首先对胸腔射线图的架构进行了开发并制定了基准,实现了最先进的性能,然后对三维CT考试进行单独模式的培训. 在36 619个被搁置的CT检查中,FORA在接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下实现了一个0.918的辐射概念识别的宏观区域,超过18个现有CT模型中最强的0.21. FORA在三项公共基准上也排名第一,在自己的测试中表现优于Merlin,没有接受该机构数据的培训(AUROC 0.907对0.826)。 根据肺栓塞、肾脏和肋骨断裂的独立局部化基准,FORA最强的空间证据属于附加说明的损伤范围,其发病率是机会的348倍。 FORA实现了比现有最强报告生成器高三倍多的宏观平均结果召回。 这些结果表明,一个单一模型可以将广泛的异常识别,空间定位和报告生成结合起来,跨越12个CT检查类型,使用常规报告,而不进行损伤级监督.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Demand for medical imaging has grown steadily over the past two decades 1 , and computed tomography (CT) use alone reached approximately 93 million examinations in the US in 2023 2 . CT combines rapid volumetric acquisition and high spatial resolution with image intensities that represent the X-ray attenuation of tissue, linearly scaled to Hounsfield units 3 , making it essential for diagnosis across anatomical regions and clinical indications. Interpreting a single examination requires identifying abnormalities across thousands of images, involving multiple organs and disease processes, and the growing number of CT studies has substantially increased radiologist workload 4 . Missed abnormalities remain an important source of diagnostic error 5 .
blocks.zh: 在过去20年里,对医疗成像的需求稳步增长,2023年2月,光是计算成像法就达到了9 300万次检查。 CT将快速的体积获取和高空间分辨率与代表组织X射线衰减的图像强度相结合,线性缩放到Hounsfield单元3 ,使得对解剖区和临床症状的诊断至关重要。 解释单一检查需要查明数千幅图像的异常情况,涉及多个器官和疾病过程,而CT研究的不断增加大大增加了放射学家的工作量。 误诊异常仍然是诊断错误的重要来源 5。

blocks.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems can detect specific diseases 6 , 7 and generate reports from volumetric images 8 , 9 . However, detecting a disease or producing a plausible report does not guarantee a thorough interpretation of an examination. Some important findings may be missed, and reported abnormalities may not have clear supporting evidence 10 , 11 . A general-purpose CT model must therefore recognize a broad range of abnormalities across anatomical regions and examination types while linking individual findings to their locations in the scan.
blocks.zh: 人工智能系统可以检测特定疾病6,7,并从体积图像8,9中生成报告. 然而,检测疾病或出具可信的报告并不能保证对检查进行透彻的解释。 一些重要的调查结果可能被忽略,所报告的异常情况可能没有明确的佐证证据。 因此,通用CT模型必须认识到解剖区和检查类型之间的广泛异常,同时将单个发现与扫描中的位置联系起来。

CT images are encoded across available clinical intensity windows (Hounsfield-unit ranges that display specific tissues, such as lung, soft tissue or bone), and concept-specific attention identifies findings and their locations to guide report generation. b , Example CT examination showing spatial evidence for multiple findings. c , Image regions supporting selected findings, paired with the corresponding generated report sentences.

blocks.en: Research towards this goal has followed two largely separate directions. CT foundation models, including CT-CLIP 12 , Merlin 13 , RADAR 14 and Pillar-0 15 , have extended recognition beyond individual diseases 16 , 17 , 18 , but covering the whole range of findings encountered across CT examination types remains challenging. In parallel, CT2Rep 8 , CT-CHAT 12 , BTB3D 19 , RadFM 9 , MedMPT 20 and NV-Reason-CT 21 have advanced report generation from volumetric images. However, coherent reports do not ensure that all relevant abnormalities have been recognized or that each statement is supported by image evidence. Grounded report generation links statements to image regions 22 , 23 , 24 , but methods requiring manually annotated bounding boxes or segmentation masks 25 , 26 are difficult to scale to the diversity of findings in routine CT. Clinical reports have reduced the annotation burden for tumor segmentation 27 , 28 , yet whether they can jointly supervise broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation remains unresolved.
blocks.zh: 为实现这一目标而进行的研究主要遵循两个不同的方向。 CT基础模型,包括CT-CLIP 12 , Merlin 13, RADAR 14 和Pridge-0 15, 已经将识别范围扩大到了单个疾病16 , 17 , 18 之外,但涵盖整个CT考试类型中遇到的发现范围仍然具有挑战性. 同时,CT2Rep 8 , CT-CHAT 12 , BTB3D 19, RadFM 9, MeDMPT 20 和 NV-Reason-CT 21 已经从量子图像中获得了先进的报告生成. 然而,连贯的报告并不能确保所有相关的异常都得到承认,或者每个陈述都得到图像证据的支持。 基础报告生成将语句连接到图像区域22、23、24,但需要手动附加说明的框或分块口罩的方法25、26很难与常规CT中的各种发现相适应。 临床报告减少了肿瘤分化的注解负担 27,28, 然而它们能否共同监督广泛的异常识别,空间定位和报告生成,仍未得到解决.

blocks.en: Routine radiology reports usually describe findings for the whole examination, but they often do not specify exactly where these findings are located. Multiple-instance learning 29 , 30 can help identify which image regions support examination-level labels, so spatial evidence can be learned without needing lesion-level annotations. Radiological concepts also help connect images with language. Concept bottleneck models 31 use clear, human-understandable concepts to guide later predictions. Combining these concepts and their spatial evidence with visual features could guide report generation while preserving information beyond a predefined vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 常规放射学报告通常描述整个检查的结果,但往往没有具体指明这些结果的位置. 多层学习29,30可以帮助识别哪些图像区域支持检查级标签,因此空间证据可以学习而不需要损伤级说明. 辐射概念也有助于将图像与语言联系起来。 概念瓶颈模型31使用清晰,人能理解的概念来指导后来的预测. 将这些概念及其空间证据与视觉特征结合起来,可以指导报告的生成,同时保留超出预定义词汇的信息.

blocks.en: Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts based on Radiopaedia 32 and uses these concepts alongside visual features to generate radiology reports (Fig. 1 ). FORA combines a self-supervised three-dimensional visual encoder, attention-based multiple-instance learning and concept-guided report generation, with supervision from routine clinical reports and no manually annotated lesions. We first developed and evaluated the approach on 286,560 chest radiograph studies with corresponding reports, achieving state-of-the-art or comparable performance on established classification, localization and report-generation benchmarks (Extended Data Fig. 1 ). We subsequently trained a separate model on volumetric CT using 304,962 examinations and evaluated it on 36,619 held-out examinations from a cohort of 341,581 examinations involving 238,469 patients. The CT cohort contains 28 acquisition protocol classes, grouped into 11 examination types and a mixed-examination category, yielding 12 categories for evaluation. A single CT model covers all 28 protocols without requiring separate models for individual organs or diseases.
blocks.zh: 我们在此介绍FORA,一种通用的CT模型,该模型基于Radiopaedia 32,识别和空间定位1,028个分级排列的放射概念,并利用这些概念与视觉特征一起生成放射学报告(图1)。 FORA将一个自我监督的三维视觉编码器,基于注意力的多层学习和概念指导的报告生成,与常规临床报告的监督,没有手动注释的损伤. 我们首先制定并评估了286 560份胸腺放射图研究方法,并提交了相应的报告,在既定分类、本地化和报告生成基准(扩展数据图1)。 我们随后利用304,962次检查,培训了一个单独的体积CT模型,并对36,619次持续检查进行了评估,这些检查来自341,581次检查,涉及238,469名病人。 CT组包括28个购置协议类,分为11个考试类型和一个混合考试类别,产生12个评价类别。 一个单一的CT模型涵盖所有28个协议,而不需要针对单个器官或疾病的单独模型.

blocks.en: FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 on held-out CT examinations, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21 (Fig. 2 a,b,e and Extended Data Fig. 2 ). It also ranked first on three public benchmarks, substantially outperforming Merlin 13 on its own test set without training on data from that institution (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826; Fig. 2 c ). Despite receiving no lesion-level supervision, FORA localized spatial evidence within independently annotated pulmonary emboli, renal cysts and masses, rib fractures and chest findings at rates up to 348 times greater than chance (Fig. 2 f and Extended Data Fig. 3 ). Its generated reports achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest of seven existing report generators (Fig. 3 and Extended Data Fig. 4 ). These results establish that routine radiology reports, which are produced for every clinical examination, are sufficient to train a single model that recognizes, localizes and reports abnormalities across 12 CT examination types, replacing lesion-level annotation and disease-specific models with supervision that already exists at scale.
blocks.zh: FORA在接收器运行特征曲线(AUROC)下实现了0.918的宏领域,在被搁置的CT测试中超过了18个现有CT模型中最强的0.21(图2 a,b,e 和扩展数据图2 ),在三个公共基准中排名第一,在未经该机构数据培训的情况下,在自己的测试组合中,它大大超过Merlin 13(AUROC 0.907对0.826;图2 c )。 尽管没有收到损伤程度的监管,FORA在独立注解的肺栓塞、肾囊肿和大块、肋骨骨折和胸腔发现的空间证据(图2f和扩展数据图3),其生成的报告的宏观平均发现召回率比7个现有报告生成器中最强的多三倍以上(图3和扩展数据图4)。 这些结果证实,为每次临床检查编写的常规放射报告足以训练一种单一的模型,在12种CT检查类型中识别、定位和报告异常情况,用已经存在的规模监督取代损害水平说明和疾病特定模型。

blocks.en: 2 Results
blocks.zh: 2 结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Data and Radiology concepts
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据和放射学概念

blocks.en: The model uses a concept bottleneck with 1,028 radiological concepts based on Radiopaedia 32 . For each examination, FORA predicts the probability of each concept and identifies supporting spatial evidence in the scan. These predictions guide report generation alongside visual features, linking recognition, localization and reporting through an explicit intermediate representation.
blocks.zh: 该模型采用了基于Radiopaedia 32的概念瓶颈,有1,028个放射性概念. 对于每次检查,FORA都会预测每个概念的概率,并在扫描中识别辅助空间证据. 这些预测与视觉特征一起指导报告的生成,通过明确的中间表示将识别、本地化和报告联系起来。

blocks.en: We collected structured labels from the routine radiology reports of 341,581 CT examinations from 238,469 patients. The scans use 28 scan protocols, which we grouped into 12 examination types for analysis. The cohort includes 136,269 chest, 82,525 head and neck, 74,556 abdominal and pelvic, 20,468 musculoskeletal, 16,459 angiographic and 11,304 multi-region or other examinations (Fig. 4 a ). We assembled a vocabulary of 1,459 concepts based on Radiopaedia 32 , covering abnormalities, anatomical variants, medical devices and postoperative states. The vocabulary is organized into a hierarchy of up to five levels, with broader concepts linked to more specific ones. Individual concepts can have multiple parents (Supplementary Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从238 469名病人的341 581次CT检查常规放射检查报告中收集了结构化标签。 扫描使用了28个扫描协议,我们将其分为12个检查类型进行分析。 组群包括136 269个胸部、82 525个头和颈、74 556个腹部和骨盆、20 468个肌肉骨骼、16 459个血管测量和11 304个多区域或其他检查(图4 a)。 我们收集了基于Radiopaedia 32的1 459个概念的词汇, 包括异常、解剖变异、医疗器械和术后状态。 词汇被组织成一个多达5个层次的层次,更广泛的概念与更具体的概念相联系. 个人概念可以有多个父母(补充图1).

blocks.en: To obtain structured labels, we developed a language-model-based pipeline that identifies concepts mentioned in each report, verifies them against quoted report text, and resolves conflicting labels (Supplementary Figs. 2 c and 3 a,b ). Of the 1,459 concepts, 1,366 appeared in the reports, and 1,028 were included as FORA’s prediction targets, each with at least 20 positive training examinations. We refined the labelling pipeline using an audit of 2,403 labelled items from 215 reports, assessed by two independent language-model judges and an adjudicating model (Supplementary Fig. 2 c ). The extracted labels also allowed us to examine concept co-occurrence within and across examination types. The resulting network contains 587 concepts connected by 1,077 edges (Fig. 4 b ). The cohort includes scanners from three manufacturers, with variation in slice spacing, labels per examination, model-input extent, patient age, report length, tube voltage and radiation dose (Fig. 4 c-h,k,l ). We also examined the frequency of individual concepts and the proportions of asserted, uncertain and denied mentions (Fig. 4 i,j ).
blocks.zh: 为了获得结构化标签,我们开发了一个基于语言模式的管道,确定每份报告中提及的概念,对照引述的报告文本加以核实,并解决相互冲突的标签(补充图)。 (b) 第2款(c)项和第3款(a)项。 在1 459个概念中,有1 366个列入报告,1 028个作为FORA的预测目标,每个概念至少有20个正面培训考试。 我们通过对215份报告中的2 403个标注项目进行审计,并经过两名独立语文模式法官和一个裁决模式(补充图2c)的评估,改进了标签程序。 抽取的标签还使我们能够审查考试类型之内和之间共同出现的概念。 由此形成的网络包含由1,077个边缘连接的587个概念(图4b. 该组包括来自三个制造商的扫描仪,在切片间隔、每次检查的标签、模型输入范围、病人年龄、报告长度、管电压和辐射剂量方面有差异(图4 c-h,k,l)。 我们还审查了个别概念的频率以及断言、不确定和否认提及的比例(图4i,j)。

blocks.en: FORA encodes all available reconstructions and intensity windows of each examination using a self-supervised three-dimensional vision transformer (Fig. 1 a and Supplementary Fig. 4 ). An attention-based multiple-instance learning head predicts each concept from image tokens across the examination and assigns attention to the regions contributing to its prediction. These concept-specific attention maps provide spatial evidence without requiring lesion-level annotations during training. Model weights, calibration parameters and decision thresholds were determined using training data only (Supplementary Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: FORA使用自控的三维视觉变压器(图1 a和补充图)编码每次检查的所有可用重建和强度窗口. 4) 一个基于关注的多层学习头从整个考试的图像符号中预测每个概念,并赋予对预测作出贡献的区域以关注. 这些针对具体概念的注意地图提供了空间证据,而不需要在培训中说明损伤程度。 模型权重、校准参数和决定阈值只使用培训数据来确定(补充图5)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Recognition performance exceeds existing CT models in every examination type
blocks.zh: 2.2 在每个考试类型中,确认成绩超过现有的CT模型

blocks.en: On held-out examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 (95% CI, 0.916-0.919), compared with 0.705 for CoLiPri 17 , the strongest of 18 comparison models. FORA also achieved higher area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC; 0.393 versus 0.146), balanced accuracy (0.837 versus 0.630) and CRG 33 (0.705 versus 0.431; all P < 0.001 P<0.001 ; Fig. 2 a ). The improvement extended across findings and examination types. FORA achieved higher average precision in 2,040 of 2,132 concept-examination-type pairs (95.7%; Fig. 2 b ). Its median AUROC advantage over the strongest alternative was positive in every examination type, ranging from 0.07 for chest CT to 0.21 for sinus and orbit CT (Fig. 2 e ). FORA also ranked first across all 12 examination types on each of the four metrics (Fig. 2 d and Extended Data Fig. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 在停产检查中,FORA在接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下实现了0.918(95%CI,0.916-0.919)的宏观领域,而CoLipri 17(18个比较模型中最强的)则达到了0.705. FORA在精准召回曲线(AUPRC;0.393对0.146),平衡精度(0.837对0.630)和CRG 33(0.705对0.431;全P < 0.001 P<0.001;图2 a)下也实现了更高的面积. 这一改进涉及调查结果和检查类型。 FORA在2,132个概念检查型对中的2,040个中实现了更高的平均精度(95.7%;图2b.)。 它的AUROC相对于最强替代品的中位优势在每一个检查类型中都是阳性,胸部CT为0.07,鼻鼻和轨道CT为0.21(图2 e.)。 FORA还在所有12个考试类型中,在4个衡量标准中各排名第一(图2d和扩展数据图2)。

blocks.en: We next examined performance across concepts with different frequencies in the training data. Average precision exceeded concept prevalence for all 1,019 concepts with at least one positive held-out patient, by a median factor of 98. Absolute average precision increased with the number of positive patients, from 0.08 for concepts with fewer than 20 positive patients to 0.75 for those with at least 1,000 (Supplementary Fig. 6 a,b ). AUROC showed a weak negative association with the number of training positives (Spearman’s ρ = − 0.20 \rho=-0.20 for CT and − 0.14 -0.14 for chest radiographs). Median AUROC was 0.944 within individual examination types and ranged from 0.94 to 0.99 across organ systems (Supplementary Fig. 6 c-g ). Mean predicted and observed concept prevalences were 1.09% and 1.10% for CT, respectively, and 0.91% and 0.92% for chest radiographs. The median expected calibration error was 0.0003 per concept (Supplementary Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们接着审查了培训数据中不同频率的各种概念的执行情况。 平均精确度超过了所有1 019个概念的流行率,其中位数是98。 绝对平均精度随着阳性病人人数的增加而增加,从20名阳性病人以下的概念的0.08增加到至少1 000名的0.75(补充图6a、b)。 AUROC显示,与训练阳性者的人数有微弱的负关系(Spearman ' s à = -0.20\rho= -0.20,CT为−0.14-0.14,胸部放射图为−0.14)。 个体考试类型中的中位数AUROC为0.944,器官系统从0.94到0.99不等(补充图6 c-g)。 平均预测和观察到的概念流行率分别是:CT的1.09%和1.10%,胸部放射图的0.91%和0.92%。 预期校准误差的中位数为每个概念0.0003(补充图7)。

blocks.en: FORA also achieved the highest AUROC on three public benchmarks, including two from institutions outside its training hospital network (Fig. 2 c ). On the Merlin test set 13 , which originates from an institution that also contributed to Merlin’s training data, FORA achieved an AUROC of 0.907 compared with 0.826 for Merlin. FORA achieved higher AUROC and average precision for 27 of the 30 evaluated concepts (Supplementary Fig. 8 a-d ). For the 21 concepts also covered by RADAR 14 , which combines organ segmentation with organ-specific finding recognition, FORA achieved an AUROC of 0.916 compared with 0.885 for RADAR when evaluated using its published protocol (Supplementary Fig. 8 e ). FORA also achieved the highest AUROC on RAD-ChestCT 34 (0.816 versus 0.796) and CT-RATE 12 (0.891 versus 0.871 for NV-Reason-CT 21 ). RAD-ChestCT originates from another institution, whereas CT-RATE shares FORA’s hospital network; patients in the CT-RATE validation set were excluded from FORA’s training data. On two additional single-finding datasets, FORA achieved an AUROC of 0.947 for rib fractures in RibFrac 35 , compared with 0.818 for the strongest alternative, and an AUROC of 0.794 for renal cysts in KiTS23 36 , exceeding all comparison models except RADAR (0.850; Supplementary Fig. 8 e ).

RAD-化学 CT来源于另一个机构,而CT-RATE则共享FORA的医院网络;CT-RATE验证组中的病人被排除在FORA的培训数据之外. 在另外两个单一调查数据集上,FORA在RibFrac 35的肋骨断裂方面实现了0.947的AUROC,而最强的替代品为0.818;在Kits23 36的肾囊肿方面实现了0.794的AUROC,超过了除RADAR(0.850;补充图8e)以外的所有比较模型。

blocks.en: We further assessed performance across patient and acquisition subgroups. Macro AUROC differed by 0.002 between sexes, 0.02 across scanner manufacturers and 0.005 across tube voltages. Across age groups, AUROC ranged from 0.873 to 0.925 for CT and from 0.871 to 0.928 for chest radiographs (Supplementary Fig. 9 ).

blocks.en: 2.3 Report supervision yields spatially accurate evidence
blocks.zh: 2.3 报告监督产生空间准确的证据

blocks.en: FORA produces a spatial evidence map for each of its 1,028 radiological concepts. We evaluated these maps using independent lesion annotations from four datasets covering pulmonary emboli, renal masses, renal cysts, rib fractures and chest findings. None of these annotations was used during training or to optimize the localization method. The centre of the strongest evidence focus, the top focus, fell within the annotated lesion substantially more often than expected by chance across all four datasets. The hit rate was 69.7% for pulmonary emboli in FUMPE 37 , 72.8% for renal masses and 66.1% for renal cysts in KiTS23, and 58.3% for rib fractures in RibFrac, corresponding to 348, 10, 41 and 188 times the probability of chance placement within the same anatomical region, respectively (Fig. 2 f and Extended Data Fig. 3 a ). On ReXGroundingCT 26 , which includes a broader range of chest findings, the top focus fell within the annotation in 27.6% of instances, 33 times the chance expectation. When considering the region containing 80% of the evidence rather than the top focus alone, overlap with the annotation was observed in 80.8-97.0% of instances across the four datasets (Extended Data Fig. 3 a ).
blocks.zh: FORA为其1 028个放射性概念中的每一个绘制了空间证据地图。 我们利用四个数据集的独立损伤说明对这些地图进行了评估,这些数据集包括肺栓塞、肾脏质量、肾囊肿、肋骨骨折和胸部发现。 这些说明都没有在训练期间使用,也没有用于优化本地化方法. 重点最强的证据中心 -- -- 最重点 -- -- 属于所有四个数据集的附带说明的损伤比预期的多得多。 FUPE 37的肺栓塞的命中率为69.7%,Kits23的肾脏部位的命中率为72.8%,肾囊肿的命中率为66.1%,RibFrac的肋骨骨骨折的命中率为58.3%,分别相当于同一解剖区的概率的348、10、41和188倍(图2f和扩展数据图3a)。 在考虑该区域80%的证据,而不是仅重心时,在四个数据集的80.8%-97.0%的情况中观察到与注释重叠(扩展数据图3 a)。

blocks.en:
We compared FORA with RADAR 14 , which localizes 146 findings within 36 segmented organs, and GLINT-CT 38 , which learns to segment findings described in free text from CT scans and reports without segmentation masks. All three models were evaluated using the same localization metrics across the four datasets, with lung nodules and pleural effusions additionally assessed separately. Targets unsupported by a model were assigned a score of zero (Extended Data Fig. 3 d ). FORA achieved higher top-focus hit rates than RADAR across all four datasets. For renal cysts, renal masses and rib fractures, the respective hit rates were 66.1%, 72.8% and 58.3% for FORA, compared with 4.8%, 36.4% and 0% for RADAR. At equal evidence-region sizes, FORA also achieved higher annotation-overlap rates in all settings except renal masses, where performance was comparable (95.7% versus 96.1%). Compared with GLINT-CT, evaluated using the threshold that maximized Dice score on each dataset as in its original study, FORA achieved higher top-focus hit rates for pulmonary emboli (69.7% versus 0%), renal cysts (66.1% versus 29.0%), renal masses (72.8% versus 53.0%) and rib fractures (58.3% versus 40.0%). Performance was similar across ReXGroundingCT findings (27.6% versus 27.9%).
At equal evidence-region sizes,
FORA had higher annotation-overlap rates than GLINT-CT for pulmonary emboli, renal cysts, renal masses, rib fractures, and pleural effusions, and similar results for lung nodules and overall ReXGroundingCT.

我们比较了FORA与RADAR 14, 它将146项发现定位在36个分块器官中, GLINT-CT 38, 它学会了通过CT扫描和没有分块口罩的报告来分块结论。 所有三个模型都使用四个数据集的相同本地化度量度进行了评价,另外还分别评估了肺结核和胸膜输液。 没有模型支持的目标被分配为0分(Extend Data Fig. 页:1 FORA在所有四个数据集中实现了高于RADAR的重心命中率. 在肾囊肿、肾脏质和肋骨骨折方面,FORA的撞击率分别为66.1%、72.8%和58.3%,而RADAR为4.8%、36.4%和0%。 在同等的物证区规模下,FORA在所有环境中也实现了更高的注解重叠率,但肾脏质量除外,其性能是相当的(95.7%对96.1%). 与GLINT-CT相比,FORA利用在最初研究中使每套数据集的Dice得分最大化的阈值进行了评价,FORA在肺栓塞(69.7%对0%)、肾囊肿(66.1%对29.0%)、肾脏质(72.8%对53.0%)和肋骨骨折(58.3%对40.0%)方面实现了更高的最高重点命中率。 在REXGtainingCT调查结论中,表现相似(27.6%对27.9%)。
在同等的证据区域大小,
FORA对肺栓塞、肾囊肿、肾脏质、肋骨骨折和胸膜精液的注解率高于GLINT-CT,对肺结核和整体ReXGroundingCT也有类似结果。

blocks.en: We further examined localization across different findings and lesion sizes. On ReXGroundingCT, top-focus hit rates were above chance in ten out of eleven categories. For mosaic attenuation, a diffuse finding without a clear focal centre, the evidence region matched the annotation in 57.1% of instances (Extended Data Fig. 3 b ). Localization improved with lesion size. Top-focus hit rates increased from 10.6% for annotations smaller than 0.5 mL to 42.2% for those of at least 50 mL, while evidence-region overlap increased from 63.0% to 93.5% (Extended Data Fig. 3 c ). To illustrate localization beyond the independently annotated datasets, Supplementary Fig. 10 presents evidence maps for 12 additional findings outside the chest, including intracerebral haemorrhage, sinus mucosal thickening, hydronephrosis, abdominal aortic aneurysm and vertebral compression fracture, using the highest- and median-probability true-positive examinations for each concept.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步研究了不同发现和损伤大小的地方化。 在 " 重围 " 中,11个类别中,10个类别中最突出的打击率高于机会。 对于没有明确协调中心的分散发现的软体衰减,证据区与57.1%的个案相符(扩展数据图3b)。 局部化随着损伤程度的提高而得到改善. 最高重点打击率从小于0.5毫升的10.6%增加到至少50毫升的42.2%,而证据区重叠率从63.0%增加到93.5%(扩展数据图3 c)。 为了说明独立附加说明的数据集之外的局部化,补充图10为胸外另外12项发现提供了证据地图,包括脑内出血、鼻窦黏膜增厚、流体内皮病、腹部主动脉瘤和脊椎压缩断裂,对每个概念都进行了最高和中位概率真实阳性检查。

blocks.en: 2.4 Concept-guided generation improves CT report completeness
blocks.zh: 2.4 概念指导生成改进CT报告的完整性

blocks.en: Our model generates radiology reports using predicted radiological concepts and their spatial evidence alongside visual features from the CT examination. The language model receives the recognized concepts with their predicted locations, sizes and supporting evidence, together with visual tokens, and is trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by direct preference optimization (DPO) 39 (Fig. 1 b,c and Supplementary Figs. 2 a,b and 11 ). This provides the language model with explicit information about individual findings while retaining access to the underlying image representations.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型利用预测的放射性概念及其空间证据以及CT检查的视觉特征生成放射学报告. 语言模型接收公认的概念及其预测位置、大小和辅助证据以及视觉符号,并使用监督的微调进行训练,然后直接优化偏好(DPO)39(图1b、c和补充图2a、b和11)。 这为语言模型提供了个人调查结果的明确信息,同时保留了获取基本图像表达方式的机会。

blocks.en:
We compared FORA with seven CT report generators, each with the prompt, decoding settings and token limit released by its developers.
Reports were scored using a common language-model-based finding extractor and a separate LLM judge (Fig. 3 and Supplementary Figs. 3 a,c and 13 ). Compared with NV-Reason-CT, the strongest alternative, FORA achieved higher macro recall (0.215 versus 0.066), precision (0.285 versus 0.132), balanced accuracy (0.606 versus 0.532) and CRG (0.467 versus 0.387). Its judge score was also higher (0.570; 95% CI, 0.566-0.573; versus 0.405; Fig. 3 b ). In direct pairwise comparisons, the judge preferred FORA’s report for 73.8% of internal examinations and NV-Reason-CT’s for 23.9%. FORA’s preference rate ranged from 59.5% for chest CT to 97.2% for head and neck CT (Extended Data Fig. 4 c ). In the example chest CT shown in Fig. 3 a , FORA recovered seven of eight reference findings, whereas no other generator recovered more than three.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了FORA与7个CT报告生成器,每个生成器都有其开发者发布的即时,解码设置和符号限制.
报告使用通用的基于语言模型的检索器和单独的LLM法官(图3和补充图3 a、c和13)打分。 与最强的替代品NV-Reason-CT相比,FORA实现了更高的宏观回溯(0.215对0.066),精度(0.285对0.132),均衡精度(0.606对0.532)和CRG(0.467对0.387). 其裁判分数也较高(0.570;95%CI,0.566-0.573;对0.405;图3b.)。 在直接对等比较中,法官倾向于FORA的73.8%的内部考试和NV-Reason-CT的23.9%。 FORA的偏好率从胸部CT的59.5%到头部和颈部CT的97.2%不等(扩展数据图4 c )。 在图3 a所示的胸部CT实例中,FORA回收了8项参考发现中的7项,而其他发电机回收的超过3项。

blocks.en: The improvement extended across body regions, acquisition protocols and report complexity. FORA outperformed all seven generators on all five evaluation measures in each of five body regions (all P < 0.01 P<0.01 ; Extended Data Fig. 4 a ). Across the 12 most frequent report protocols, FORA achieved the highest CRG and judge scores, as well as the highest or equal balanced accuracy and recall (Fig. 3 c ). It also achieved the highest CRG and judge scores across all 17 protocols with at least 200 examinations and the pooled remaining protocols (Extended Data Fig. 4 b ). FORA ranked first across all levels of report complexity, and the number of findings in its generated reports increased with the number documented in the reference reports (Fig. 3 d ).
blocks.zh: 改进范围扩大到各个机构区域、采购协议和报告的复杂性。 FORA在五个体区(全部P < 0.01 P < 0.01;扩展数据图4 a)的所有五个评价措施上都超过了所有七个发电机。 在12个最频繁的报告协议中,FORA取得了最高的CRG和评分,以及最高的或相等的平衡的准确性和召回性(图3 c.). 它还在所有17个协议中取得了最高的CRG和评分,至少进行了200次考试,并完成了集合剩余协议(Extend Data Fig). 4 b. (中文(简体) ). FORA在报告复杂性的各个层面排名第一,其生成的报告中的调查结果数量随着参考报告(图3d)中记录的数量而增加。

blocks.en: We also evaluated report generation on external benchmarks. On the Merlin test set, FORA outperformed all comparison generators, including Merlin’s report generator trained at the institution from which the test set originated. FORA achieved a judge score of 0.325 compared with 0.260 for the strongest alternative, and approximately twice its recall (0.101 versus 0.050). On CT-RATE, which was used to train NV-Reason-CT, FORA achieved higher recall (0.277 versus 0.233) and balanced accuracy (0.623 versus 0.603), while matching NV-Reason-CT on precision and CRG. Judge scores were also comparable (0.675 versus 0.679; Fig. 3 e ). On internal validation, 32.3% of FORA’s reports received a perfect judge score, increasing to 50.6% for head and neck CT (Extended Data Fig. 4 d ). A breakdown of the judge assessments is provided in Extended Data Fig. 4 e . Supplementary Fig. 14 presents four additional examinations with reports from all eight generators.
blocks.zh: 我们还评价了外部基准的报告编制情况。 在梅林测试机组上,FORA的性能超过了所有比较发电机,包括梅林在测试机组发源地机构训练的报告发电机. FORA的评委得分为0.325分,而最强的选手则为0.260分,其召回率约为两倍(0.101比0.050). 在用于训练NV-Reason-CT的CT-RATE上,FORA实现了更高的回溯(0.277比0.233)和平衡精确度(0.623比0.603),同时在精确度和CRG上与NV-Reason-CT相匹配. 法官的分数也是可比的(0.675比0.679;图3e)。 在内部验证中,FORA32.3%的报告获得了完美的评委分数,头部和颈部的CT(扩展数据图4d )增加到50.6%。 法官评估的细目见扩展数据图表。 4 e. 补充图14载有所有8台发电机的报告,增加了4次考试。

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of preference optimization, we compared the supervised writer before and after DPO using identical finding plans and evaluation procedures (Supplementary Fig. 12 ). On 500 CT validation examinations, the supervised writer omitted 72.1% of the reference findings included in its input plan, compared with 40.8% after DPO. Micro-averaged recall increased from 0.255 to 0.531 and F1 from 0.385 to 0.592 (Supplementary Fig. 12 a ). The mean number of findings per generated report increased from 2.8 to 7.1, compared with 9.6 in the reference reports (Supplementary Fig. 12 b ), and omissions decreased across every body region (Supplementary Fig. 12 c ). On 28,965 chest radiograph validation examinations, the same training procedure increased recall from 0.262 to 0.417, balanced accuracy from 0.547 to 0.592 and CRG from 0.403 to 0.459 (Supplementary Fig. 12 d,e ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估优化优惠的贡献,我们用相同的发现计划和评价程序(补充图12)比较了受监督的作者在DPO前后的情况。 在500个CT验证考试中,被监督的编剧省略了72.1%的输入计划中包含的参考结果,而DPO之后的引用率为40.8%. 微观平均召回率从0.255增加到0.531,F1从0.385增加到0.592(补充图12 a.)。 每份报告得出的平均调查结果从2.8项增加到7.1项,而参考报告为9.6项(补充图12b),每个机构的遗漏减少(补充图12c)。 在28,965次胸腔射线鉴定考试中,同一训练程序将回调从0.262提高到0.417,平衡精度从0.547提高到0.592,CRG从0.403提高到0.459(补充图12 d,e.).

blocks.en: 2.5 Development and benchmarking on chest radiographs
blocks.zh: 2.5 胸形放射图的发展和基准

blocks.en: We first developed and systematically evaluated FORA’s architecture on chest radiographs before adapting it to volumetric CT. Chest radiographs provided established public benchmarks for classification, localization and report generation, allowing us to compare architectural choices and evaluate all three tasks against released models (Extended Data Fig. 1 ). The radiograph model was trained on 257,595 studies using labels extracted from routine reports and evaluated on 28,965 internal validation studies and five public test sets. These experiments established the performance of the approach on two-dimensional images before its extension to CT, rather than evaluating a CT-trained model on radiographs.
blocks.zh: 我们首先开发并系统评价了FORA在胸腔射线图上的建筑,然后将其适应体积CT. 胸腔放射图为分类,本地化和报告生成提供了既定的公共基准,使我们能够比较建筑选择,并对照发布的模型(Extend Data Fig. 1 )评价所有三项任务. 使用从例行报告中提取的标签对257 595项研究进行了放射图模型的培训,并对28 965项内部验证研究和5项公共测试进行了评估。 这些实验确定了该方法在扩展至CT之前在二维图像上的性能,而不是评价辐射图上的CT训练模型.

blocks.en: For classification, FORA matched or exceeded the strongest of seven released models across all six evaluation sets (Extended Data Fig. 1 b ). On internal validation, FORA achieved a macro AUROC of 0.954 (95% CI, 0.949-0.960) across the 128 of its 129 radiological concepts with validation positives, compared with 0.866 for RadZero 40 . It achieved higher average precision for 108 of the 128 concepts and ranked first on AUROC, AUPRC, balanced accuracy and CRG across all ten concept categories (Extended Data Fig. 1 c,d ). On public benchmarks, FORA achieved AUROCs of 0.877 on RSNA Pneumonia 41 , 0.865 on Open-I 42 and 0.813 on ChestX-Det10 43 , compared with 0.864, 0.847 and 0.796 for the strongest alternatives, respectively. Performance was comparable to CARZero 44 on ChestX-ray14 45 (0.811 versus 0.811) and PadChest-GR 46 (0.863 versus 0.862).
blocks.zh: 对于分类,FORA匹配或超过了所有六个评价组中七个发布模型中最强的(扩展数据图1 b )。 在内部验证方面,FORA在其129个放射性概念中有128个有验证阳性,其宏观AUROC为0.954(95% CI,0.949-0.960),而RadZero 40则为0.866。 在128个概念中,108个概念的平均精度较高,在AUROC、AUPRC、均衡精度和CRG在所有10个概念类别中排名第一(扩展数据图1 c,d)。 在公共基准方面,FORA在RSNA肺炎41、开放I42和胸口1043上分别实现了0.877、0.865和0.813的AUROC,而最强替代品分别为0.864、0.847和0.796。 性能与CARZERO 44在胸X射线14 45(0.811对0.811)和PadChest-GR 46(0.863对0.862)相当.

blocks.en: FORA is able to localize findings without using bounding-box supervision. Across four test sets with radiologist-annotated boxes, the peak of the strongest evidence focus fell within the annotation for 66.9-89.2% of finding instances, corresponding to five to ten times the chance expectation. FORA achieved higher localization hit rates than all comparison models producing spatial maps, with statistically significant differences in 22 of 24 comparisons (Extended Data Fig. 1 e,f ). In report generation, FORA recovered more reference findings than six comparison generators (macro recall 0.321 versus 0.213) and had fewer clinically significant errors per examination (0.47 versus 0.57; Extended Data Fig. 1 g ). Recall remained between 0.34 and 0.45 across groups stratified by the number of reference findings, compared with a maximum of 0.27 for the other generators (Extended Data Fig. 1 h ). In the example shown in Extended Data Fig. 1 a , FORA recovered four of six reference findings, whereas no other generator recovered more than one.
blocks.zh: FORA能够在不使用边框监督的情况下将发现本地化. 在有放射学家注解箱的四套测试中,最强证据焦点的峰值在66.9%-89.2%的发现案例中属于注解范围,相当于概率预期的五至十倍。 FORA的本地化命中率高于制作空间地图的所有比较模型,在24个比较中的22个有统计上的重大差异(扩展数据图1 e,f )。 在报告生成中,FORA比6个比较生成器(宏观召回0.321比0.213)回收了更多的参考结果,每次检查在临床上的重大错误较少(0.47比0.57;扩展数据图1g.). 按参考调查结果数量分级的各类召回数仍然在0.34至0.45之间,而其他发电机的召回数最多为0.27(扩展数据图1 h)。 在扩展数据图中显示的例子中。 1 a,FORA收回了6项参考调查结果中的4项,而其他任何发电机都找不到一个以上的。

blocks.en: 2.6 Learned representations encode tissue measurements and stable patient-specific profiles
blocks.zh: 2.6 学会的表达方式编码组织测量和稳定的患者特定特征

blocks.en: We examined how FORA’s predicted radiological concepts characterize examinations across the cohort. Clustering the 1,028-dimensional concept profiles identified 16 groups with distinct anatomical distributions and patterns of reported findings (Extended Data Fig. 6 ). These included groups enriched for turbinate hypertrophy, brain atrophy, coronary stenosis, urinary calculi and fractures. To examine variation within anatomical regions, we repeated the analysis separately for head, chest, abdomen, neck, cardiac and spine CT. Each region contained six groups with different combinations of findings, including pulmonary nodules and pleural effusions in chest CT, urinary calculi and ovarian cysts in abdominal CT, and spinal stenosis and compression fractures in spine CT (Extended Data Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 我们研究了FORA预测的放射性概念如何描述整个组群的检查。 将1,028维概念剖面组合起来,确定了16个组别,这些组别具有明显的解剖分布和报告结果的模式(扩展数据图6)。 其中包括多发性高血压、脑萎缩、冠状动脉硬化、泌尿性钙和骨折等增殖组。 为了检查解剖区域内的变异,我们分别对头部,胸部,腹部,颈部,心脏和脊椎CT进行了分析. 每个区域都有六组不同的结论组合,包括胸腔CT中的肺结核和胸腔精液,腹腔CT中的泌尿性钙和卵巢囊,脊椎CT中的脊椎增生和压缩骨折(扩展数据图7)。
