blocks.zh: 图4:在238 469名病人的341 581次CT检查中,FORA组群和报告产生的监督。 a,按CT类型分列的考试数。 b. 寻找共犯网络。 c. 扫描仪制造商和型号。 d-f),切片间隔,每次检查的正标签和模型输入范围按CT类型. g,病人年龄。 h,按CT类型报告长度。 i,标签频率跨越1,459个概念的等级。 j,每份报告都有不确定和否定的标签。 k,l,管电压和体积CT剂量指数(CTDIvol).

blocks.en: We next examined whether FORA’s visual representations retained quantitative anatomical information not explicitly included in its concept vocabulary. Using 12,700 examinations, we fitted out-of-fold linear readouts to predict liver attenuation, L3 muscle attenuation, aortic calcification and L1 vertebral attenuation from features of the self-supervised image encoder. Predicted values correlated with the corresponding measurements, with Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.990, 0.972, 0.861 and 0.819, respectively (Supplementary Fig. 15 a-d ). The readouts also tracked within-patient changes between examinations, with Spearman correlations ranging from 0.51 to 0.94 (Supplementary Fig. 15 e-h,j ). Readouts based on features from the relevant anatomical region had lower prediction errors than those using age, sex and tube voltage or features from another organ (Supplementary Fig. 15 i ). Bland-Altman analyses of agreement between predicted and measured values are shown in Supplementary Fig. 15 k-n .
blocks.zh: 我们接着审查FORA的视觉表达是否保留了数量解剖学信息,但没有明确地纳入其概念词汇. 通过12 700次检查,我们安装了双倍线性读数,预测肝衰减、L3肌肉衰减、主动性钙化和L1脊椎衰减来自自我监督图像编码器的特征。 预测值与相应的测量相关,皮尔逊相关系数分别为0.990,0.972,0.861和0.819(补充图15 a-d.). 阅读结果还跟踪检查之间病人内部的变化,斯皮尔曼的关联性从0.51到0.94不等(补充图15e-h,j.)。 根据相关解剖区域特征的读取,预测误差低于使用年龄、性别和管电压的误差或来自另一器官的误差(补充图15i)。 Bland-Altman对预测值和测量值之间一致的分析见补充图15 k-n。

blocks.en: We also assessed whether FORA’s concept predictions remained consistent across repeated examinations of the same patient. The cohort included 45,669 patients scanned on at least two dates, with 56,395 intervals between examinations of the same type (Extended Data Fig. 5 ). Among 3,009 matched pairs, concept profiles from repeated examinations of the same patient had a mean cosine similarity of 0.879, compared with 0.754 for matched examinations from different patients, a difference of 0.126 (95% CI, 0.122-0.130; Supplementary Fig. 16 a ). The difference was observed in six of seven CT categories and persisted when imaging site, contrast administration or scanner manufacturer differed between examinations (0.130 under unchanged conditions versus 0.118 when conditions changed; Supplementary Fig. 16 b,e ). It was 0.155 for examinations performed within 30 days and remained 0.098 for those separated by more than one year. Repeated examinations belonged to the same concept-profile group in 66-74% of pairs, compared with 50-59% of matched examinations from different patients (Supplementary Fig. 16 c,d,f,g ). Thus, FORA’s visual representations retain quantitative tissue information, while its concept predictions capture anatomical and patient-specific patterns that remain relatively consistent across examinations.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估FORA的概念预测在对同一个病人的反复检查中是否仍然一致. 该组包括至少两个日期扫描的45 669名病人,同一类型检查间隔为56 395次(扩展数据图5)。 在3 009对对应病例中,同一患者反复检查的概念剖面值为0.879,而不同患者的对应检查为0.754,差额为0.126(95%为CI,0.122-0.130;补充图16 a)。 在7个CT类别中,有6个类别观察到了这种差异,在成像场、对比管理或扫描仪制造商之间出现差异(在不变条件下为0.130,在条件发生变化时为0.118;补充图16b、e)时,这种差异继续存在。 在30天内进行的考试为0.155次,离职一年以上的考试为0.098次。 重复检查在66-74%的对子中属于同一概念类,而来自不同病人的对应检查为50-59%(补充图16 c、d、f、g)。 因此,FORA的视觉表现保留了定量组织信息,而其概念预测则捕捉了各个检查中相对一致的解剖和患者特异性模式.

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: CT models have progressed from single-disease detectors to foundation models trained on large collections of images and reports, including CT-CLIP 12 , Merlin 13 and Pillar-0 15 . These models have broadened the range of recognizable abnormalities, but recognition, spatial localization and report generation have largely been studied as separate tasks. Clinical CT interpretation requires all three across examinations that differ substantially in anatomy, acquisition and pathology. FORA brings these capabilities together in a single model, recognizing 1,028 radiological concepts across 28 scan protocols, associating them with spatial evidence and using the predicted concepts alongside visual features to generate reports.
blocks.zh: CT模型已从单病探测器发展为基础模型,对大型图像和报告收集工作进行了培训,包括CT-CLIP 12、Merlin 13和支柱0-15。 这些模型拓宽了可识别异常的范围,但识别,空间定位和报告生成大多作为单独的任务进行研究. 临床CT解释要求所有三项检查在解剖学,获取学和病理学上都有很大差异. FORA将这些能力汇集在一个单一的模型中,通过28个扫描协议识别1 028个放射性概念,将它们与空间证据联系起来,并利用预测的概念与视觉特征一起生成报告.

blocks.en: FORA was trained on 304,962 examinations using routine clinical reports without lesion-level annotations (Fig. 5 ). It performed better than 18 comparison models in 95.7% of the evaluated concept-examination-type pairs, and these improvements also appeared in external benchmarks, including the Merlin test set. Its spatial evidence maps identified independently annotated abnormalities at rates well above chance in five evaluation settings, and its generated reports recovered approximately three times as many documented findings as the strongest comparison generator. The approach was first developed on chest radiographs, where it also matched or set the standard in classification, localization and report-generation benchmarks. Thus, our results indicate that broad concept recognition, weakly supervised localization and report generation can be combined across different imaging modalities without requiring separate models for individual diseases.
blocks.zh: FORA接受了304,962次检查培训,使用常规的临床报告,没有损伤等级说明(图5). 它在95.7%的评价概念检查型对中表现优于18个比较模型,这些改进也出现在外部基准中,包括梅林测试套. 其空间证据地图在五个评价环境中以远高于机会的比率发现了独立说明的异常情况,其生成的报告是最强的比较生成器的三倍左右。 这种方法最初是针对胸腔放射图制定的,其中它也符合或设定了分类、本地化和报告生成基准的标准。 因此,我们的结果表明,广泛的概念认识、薄弱的监管地方化和报告生成可以跨不同成像模式相结合,而不需要针对个别疾病的单独模型。

blocks.en: Several parts of our approach contribute to these capabilities. First, FORA uses explicit supervision for a large set of radiological concepts taken from clinical reports. Unlike contrastive image-text models, which typically infer individual findings through similarities between image and text representations, FORA directly predicts each concept from image features. This allows the model to represent findings independently of the wording used to describe them at inference time, although the quality and frequency of their documentation still affect training. Furthermore, attention-based multiple-instance learning associates examination-level concept labels with image regions. Anatomical routing focuses the search for supporting evidence on relevant regions but still keeps information from the whole examination. This lets the system learn spatial evidence maps without needing lesion-level supervision. FORA uses these clear concept predictions in report generation, along with visual tokens. The concept pathway gives a structured way to represent recognized abnormalities and their supporting evidence. The visual pathway lets the language model use information outside the set vocabulary. Preference optimization also made reports more complete by reducing missed findings from the generation plan.
blocks.zh: 我们方法的几个部分促进了这些能力。 首先,FORA对从临床报告中摘取的大量放射性概念使用明确的监督. 与对比的图像-文本模型一般通过图像和文本表达的相似性推断出单个发现不同,FORA直接从图像特征来预测每个概念. 这使得模型能够独立于推断时描述这些结果所使用的措辞来代表结果,尽管其文件的质量和频率仍然影响培训。 此外,基于注意力的多层学习联系人考试一级的概念标签带有图像区域。 解剖路线将寻找辅助证据的重点放在相关区域,但仍保留整个检查过程中的信息。 这使得系统可以学习空间证据地图,而不需要损伤层面的监督. FORA在报告生成中使用这些清晰的概念预测,以及视觉符号. 概念路径提供了一种结构化的方式来代表公认的异常及其佐证。 视觉路径让语言模型在设定词汇表外使用信息. 优化优惠也使报告更加完整,减少了发电计划中遗漏的调查结果。

blocks.en:
The combination of broad recognition and spatial evidence could support several aspects of clinical CT interpretation. Predicting a large vocabulary of abnormalities may help identify incidental findings outside the primary clinical question, including abnormalities that might otherwise receive less attention during a focused examination. Linking concept predictions to image regions could also make AI-generated reports easier to review, allowing radiologists to inspect the evidence associated with individual findings.
These predictions could help prioritize worklists for a wider range of abnormalities than systems focused only on specific emergencies. However, using them for triage would need future studies to check sensitivity, calibration, and clinical impact. FORA’s visual outputs also keep quantitative details about tissue attenuation and calcification, which could be useful for assessing existing CT scans opportunistically 47 . Using a single model for different exam types might also make it unnecessary to manage separate disease-specific systems, as long as its performance is proven for the intended clinical use.
blocks.zh:
广泛识别和空间证据的结合可以支持临床CT解释的几个方面. 预测大量异常的词汇可能有助于确定初级临床问题以外的偶然发现,包括在重点检查期间可能较少受到注意的异常。 将概念预测与图像区域联系起来也可使AI生成的报告更容易审查,使放射学家能够检查与个别调查结果有关的证据。
这些预测可以帮助确定工作清单的优先次序,以便确定范围更广的异常情况,而不是仅仅侧重于具体紧急情况的系统。 然而,利用它们进行分解将需要今后的研究来检查灵敏度、校准和临床影响。 FORA的视觉输出还保留了组织衰减和钙化方面的量化细节,这可能有助于对现有CT扫描进行机会性评估 47。 对不同的检查类型采用单一模式,也可能使得没有必要管理单独的疾病特定系统,只要其性能被证明用于预期的临床用途。

blocks.en: The representation analyses provide further insight into what FORA learns from routine examinations. Predicted concept profiles separated examinations into groups characterized by different anatomical regions and combinations of findings, while quantitative tissue measurements could be recovered from the visual encoder using linear readouts. Repeated examinations from the same patient also had more similar concept profiles than matched examinations from different patients, including when acquisition conditions changed or scans were separated by more than a year. These observations suggest that FORA retains both continuous anatomical information and relatively stable patient-specific imaging characteristics. They do not establish that the model can assess disease progression, but they provide a basis for extending it to longitudinal interpretation. Incorporating prior examinations could allow future models to distinguish new, persistent and resolving abnormalities rather than interpreting each study independently.
blocks.zh: 代表性分析使人们进一步深入了解论坛从例行考试中吸取的教训。 预测的概念剖面将检查分为不同解剖区和结果组合的组别,而定量组织测量则可以通过线性读取从视觉编码器中恢复. 同一患者的重复检查,其概念简介也比不同患者的匹配检查更为相似,包括购买条件发生变化或扫描分离一年多时. 这些观测结果表明,FORA既保留连续解剖信息,又保留相对稳定的患者特定成像特征. 它们并未确定该模型能够评估疾病进展,但为将其扩大到纵向解释提供了依据。 纳入先前的检查可使未来的模型区分新的、持续的和解决的异常情况,而不是独立地解释每项研究。

blocks.en:
Several limitations remain. FORA was trained on examinations from one hospital network, with reports translated into English. Although performance was evaluated on external datasets, differences in patient populations, imaging protocols and reporting practices may affect generalization to other healthcare systems 48 . The concept labels were extracted from routine reports and therefore inherit their omissions, uncertainty and institutional reporting conventions. In particular, an unmentioned finding cannot always be assumed to be absent. The localization experiments used independent annotations across several anatomical regions, but quantitative validation was limited to concepts with suitable annotations. Accurate classification does not guarantee accurate localization 49 , and evidence maps for concepts without suitable annotations have not been systematically validated. FORA’s evidence decomposes the study logit exactly into regional contributions 50 , but these contributions are distinct from causal dependence, which would require interventional tests such as occluding the highlighted region 51 , 52 .
For report generation, we mainly used an automated finding extractor and language-model judges. These tools help compare models consistently, but they cannot replace independent clinical review.
blocks.zh:
仍然存在若干限制。 FORA接受一个医院网络的检查培训,报告被翻译成英文。 虽然对外部数据集的绩效进行了评价,但患者人数、成像协议和报告做法的差异可能影响对其他保健系统的普及。 概念标签摘自例行报告,从而继承了其遗漏、不确定性和机构报告公约。 特别是,不能总是假定不存在未提及的调查结果。 本地化实验在多个解剖区使用独立说明,但定量验证仅限于有适当说明的概念. 准确的分类并不能保证准确的本地化 49,没有适当说明的概念的证据地图也没有系统验证. FORA的证据将研究完全分为50个区域贡献,但这些贡献不同于因果依赖,这需要干预性测试,如覆盖突出的区域51、52。
对于报告生成,我们主要使用自动搜索提取器和语言模型法官。 这些工具有助于一致地比较模型,但它们不能取代独立的临床审查.

blocks.en: Clinical validation is needed to determine whether these improvements translate into more accurate and efficient radiological interpretation and downstream patient benefits. Radiologist assessment of finding-level accuracy, report completeness, clinically significant errors and spatial evidence will be important, as will reader studies measuring the effect of FORA assistance on interpretation time and diagnostic performance 53 . Future work could also extend the concept vocabulary and investigate the approach in other volumetric modalities, including MRI, where routine reports provide examination-level supervision but detailed spatial annotations remain limited. FORA shows that routine radiology reports can help recognize many radiological concepts and their locations, and these insights can support report generation along with visual features. By bringing these abilities together across different CT scans, this method lays the groundwork for more general-purpose systems in radiological interpretation.
blocks.zh: 需要进行临床验证,以确定这些改进是否转化为更准确和高效的放射解释和下游病人的利益。 放射学家对发现水平准确性、报告完整性、临床重大误差和空间证据的评估以及衡量FORA援助对解释时间和诊断性能的影响的读者研究都十分重要。 今后的工作还可以扩大概念词汇,并研究其他卷法方法,包括磁共振法,其中例行报告提供检查一级的监督,但详细的空间说明仍然有限。 FORA显示常规放射学报告可以帮助识别许多放射概念及其位置,这些见解可以支持报告与视觉特征的生成. 通过把这些能力汇集到不同的CT扫描中,这种方法为辐射解释方面更多的通用系统奠定了基础.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Cohort and data preparation
blocks.zh: 4.1 汇编和数据编制

blocks.en: We retrospectively collected 341,581 CT examinations from 238,469 patients at one hospital network. Each examination comprised a radiology report and the images described in that report. Examinations were assigned to 28 protocol classes. 27 CT protocols and dental cone-beam CT, which accounted for 65 examinations. These classes were grouped into 11 examination types and a mixed category for examinations spanning multiple types (Fig. 4 ). We split the cohort by patient into a training set of 304,962 examinations from 213,106 patients and a held-out set of 36,619 examinations from 25,363 patients, with no patient overlap. The training set excluded all CT-RATE 12 validation studies, including the 414 ReXGroundingCT 26 studies used for evaluation (Supplementary Fig. 5 a ).
blocks.zh: 我们从一个医院网络的238 469名病人中追溯收集了341 581份CT检查。 每次检查包括一份放射报告和报告中描述的图像。 考试分配到28个礼宾班。 27 CT协议和牙科锥束CT,占65次检查. 这些班级分为11个考试类别和一个跨多个类型考试的混合类别(图4)。 我们把患者分成由213 106名患者组成的304 962个培训组和由25 363名患者组成的36 619个培训组,没有病人重叠。 这套培训不包括所有CT-RATE 12项鉴定研究,包括用于评价的414项REXGtainingCT 26项研究(补充图5 a)。

blocks.en: Each usable series was resampled to a voxel spacing of 1.5 × \times 0.5 × \times 0.5 mm, cropped to the body and represented by multiple intensity views. These included the full range from − 1,000 -1{,}000 to 1,000 1{,}000 HU, each distinct window stored in the DICOM header and, when a lung window with a center below − 250 -250 HU was present, a 10 mm lung maximum-intensity projection. All views from an examination formed its study bag. The training set contained 856,181 series and 2,332,070 views (Supplementary Fig. 1 ). Reports were anonymized, translated from Turkish into English using Gemma-4-31B-it 54 and structured into sections. Findings and Impression sections were used for labeling.
4.2 Report labels and finding hierarchy
blocks.zh: 4.2 报告标签和查找等级

blocks.en: Each report was labeled against a closed vocabulary of 1,459 radiological concepts, which covers abnormalities, anatomical variants, devices and postoperative states and which we refer to as findings. Its 1,286 specific concepts were extracted from Radiopaedia 32 and extended with findings that radiologists reported in the corpus, such as devices and postoperative states. We arranged them in a hierarchy of up to five levels by adding 173 umbrella concepts, including the classes of the CT-RATE 12 and Merlin 13 benchmarks and groups by organ and disease process, and by linking each concept to the more general concepts it implies. A concept can have several parents, and 150 of the 1,366 concepts that occur in the corpus have more than one (Supplementary Fig. 1 ). Gemma-4-31B-it labeled the Findings and Impression sections in three passes. The first extracted candidate findings from the vocabulary, the second verified each against a verbatim quote from the report, and the third applied the verification and re-checked commonly missed findings. Each label received the state asserted, uncertain or denied (Supplementary Figs. 2 c and 3 a,b ). Positive labels were combined with those of an earlier extraction with the same rules, and free-text findings whose name matched a vocabulary entry were added as asserted.
blocks.zh: 每份报告都以包含1 459个放射概念的封闭词汇为标签,其中包括异常、解剖变异、装置和术后状态,我们称之为调查结果。 其1,286个具体概念摘自第32号无线电台,并扩展了放射学家在放射体中报告的调查结果,如装置和术后状态。 我们通过增加173个总括概念,包括按器官和疾病过程划分的CT-RATE 12和Merlin 13的基准和类别,并通过将每个概念与它所隐含的更一般的概念联系起来,将它们分为五级。 一个概念可以有好几个父母,在主体中发生的1 366个概念中有150个有不止一个(补充图1)。 Gemma-4-31B-it将"发现"和"印象"两部分标注为3个通行证. 第一份从词汇中提取了候选人的结论,第二份从报告中逐字逐句核实了每个结果,第三份从中核实并重新检查了通常遗漏的调查结果。 每个标签都收到声称、不确定或否认的状态(补充数字)。 (b) 第2款(c)项和第3款(a)项。 正面标签与早先用同样规则提取的标签合并,并按要求添加了与词汇条目相符的免费文本结论。

blocks.en: Further passes with the same model refined the labels. A recall pass added 197,769 asserted labels in 145,484 reports, each confirmed by a separate verification call with a verbatim quote. A malignancy check flagged cancer labels that referred only to history (10,804) or were unsupported (952), an adjudication pass settled conflicts between positive and denied labels, and a mapping pass assigned free-text findings to the vocabulary. Remaining conflicts were resolved in favour of the positive label. Asserted and uncertain labels were then propagated to all ancestors in the hierarchy and denials to all descendants. A finding counted as positive when it was asserted or uncertain, and findings that a report did not mention were treated as negative. We audited an earlier version of the extraction with two independent language-model judges and an adjudicating model, covering 2,403 labelled items in 215 reports. The audit found recurring errors, which we used to create prompt rules and guide the recall pass.
blocks.zh: 与同一型号进一步通过,改进了标签。 一张召回证在145 484份报告中增加了197 769个标签,每份标签均由单独核查电话和逐字记录证实。 恶性检查标记的癌症标签只提及历史(10,804)或不支持(952),裁决通过解决了正标签和否定标签之间的冲突,地图通过为词汇分配了自由文本结果。 剩余的冲突得到了有利于正面标签的解决。 然后,向等级体系中的所有祖先宣传了过时和不确定的标签,向所有后代宣传否认。 如果断言或不确定,调查结果被认为是正面的,而报告没有提到的调查结果则被视为负面的。 我们与两名独立的语言模式法官和一个裁决模式一起审计了早先的摘录,涉及215份报告中的2 403个标注项目。 审计发现一再出现错误,我们用这些错误来制定及时的规则并指导召回通行证。

blocks.en: Findings with at least 200 positive and 200 negative training examinations (749) received their own classifier head. Findings with 20 to 199 positives (279) were attached to their nearest ancestor with its own head, initialized from it and regularized towards it during training. This gave 1,028 targets. Eighty-six rare findings without such an ancestor and two findings that are not visible on CT were not modeled.
blocks.zh: 至少有200次正面和200次负面培训考试的结果(749次)得到了他们自己的分类主管。 20至199名阳性者(279人)的检测结果附在他们最近的祖先身上,并有自己的头部,从头部上初始化,并在培训期间向它正规化。 这给1028个目标。 86个没有这种祖先的罕见发现和两个在CT上不可见的发现都没有模型化.

blocks.en: 4.3 Image encoder
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 图像编码器

blocks.en: The image encoder is a three-dimensional ViT-L 55 with 24 blocks, an embedding dimension of 1,024, four register tokens 56 and 302.9 million parameters (Fig. 5 a ). Each image token covers 2 × \times 16 × \times 16 voxels, corresponding to 3 × \times 8 × \times 8 mm. Positions are encoded in millimetres using three-dimensional rotary embeddings 57 . We trained the encoder from scratch without labels using self-distillation 58 , combining the DINO 59 , iBOT 60 and KoLeo 61 objectives with a cross-crop patch term. All stages respected the patient-level split.
blocks.zh: 图像编码器是一个三维的ViT-L 55,有24个块,嵌入维度为1,024,4个寄存符56和30,290万参数(图5 a.). 每个图像符号覆盖2×时 16×时 16×时 16 voxel,对应3×时 8×时 8 mm. 位置以毫米编码,使用三维旋转嵌入式57. 我们从零开始训练没有标签的编码器 使用自消化58, 结合DINO 59, iBOT 60 和 KoLeo 61 的目标 一个跨作物补丁术语。 所有阶段都尊重病人之间的分化。

blocks.en: Each sample consisted of one reconstruction and yielded two global crops of 64 × \times 192 × \times 192 voxels and eight local crops of 32 × \times 96 × \times 96 voxels. The teacher received one global crop in the full intensity range and another in an intensity window sampled from the full range and the series’ native windows. When a lung window was present, the second view was replaced with a 10 mm lung maximum-intensity projection with probability 0.25. The student received additional intensity perturbations and iBOT masking.
blocks.zh: 每个样本包括一次重建,并产生了两次全球农作物,分别为64×时192×时192伏牛,八次当地农作物32×时96×时96伏牛. 老师从全场和系列原生窗口抽取了一个全球农作物, 当一个肺窗出现时,第二景改为10毫米肺最大强度投影,概率为0.25. 该学生获得了额外的强度扰动和iBOT遮罩.

blocks.en: Training ran for 20,000 steps with a global batch size of 1,024 reconstructions on 128 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, followed by 5,000 steps with an additional Gram-anchoring loss 62 . This loss kept pairwise similarities between the student’s patch features close to those of a frozen copy of the teacher from step 20,000. Blocks 1 to 23 of the teacher were frozen for all subsequent stages.
blocks.zh: 在128个NVIDIA H200 GPU上,培训为20 000步,全球批量规模为1 024次重建,随后是5 000步,另外还有Gram-anchoring损失62。 这种损失使学生的补丁特征与20 000级教师的冷冻副本相似。 该教师的第1至23栏被冻结,用于随后的所有阶段。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : FORA learns finding recognition, spatial localization and report generation from routine CT examinations and reports. a , Self-supervised teacher–student distillation across clinical intensity windows. b , Contrastive alignment of CT features with report sentences. c , Concept-specific attention learns finding recognition and spatial evidence from report-derived labels. d , Concept-guided report generation trained through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
blocks.zh: 图5:FORA通过常规CT考试和报告学习识别,空间定位和报告生成. a, 自我监督的教师- 学生在临床强度窗口的蒸馏。 b. CT特征与报告句不一致。 c. 具体概念的注意从报告的标签中找到识别和空间证据。 d. 通过监督微调(SFT)和直接优化偏好(DPO)培训概念指导报告生成。

blocks.en: 4.4 Alignment with report sentences
blocks.zh: 4.4 与报告句一致

blocks.en: Before training the classifier, we trained block 24 with its final normalization layer, a 512-dimensional projection and a view-type embedding contrastively against the statements of presence and absence derived from each training report (Fig. 5 b ). The statements were encoded by a fine-tuned CXR-BERT 63 , and the loss treated all statements of a report as positives. Training ran for ten epochs on 304,921 training reports, three with a cosine schedule and seven of a continuation at half the learning rate. This block initialized the trainable block of the classifier.
blocks.zh: 在培训分类员之前,我们训练了第24组,其最后的正常化层、512维投影和视线类型的嵌入与每个培训报告所显示的存在和缺失形成对比(图5b)。 报表由经过微调的CXR-BERT 63编码,损失将报告的所有报表视为正数. 培训涉及304 921份培训报告,其中3份带有余弦,7份以学习率的一半继续进行。 这个区块初始化了分类器的可列车区块.

blocks.en: 4.5 Organ-routed multiple-instance classifier
blocks.zh: 4.5 机关路由多管分类器

blocks.en: The classifier treats each examination as a bag of image tokens from all its views (Fig. 5 c and Supplementary Fig. 4 ). The frozen block-23 tokens pass through the trainable block 24 and its final layer norm. Its outputs are standardized with fixed statistics and extended with 24 Fourier features 64 of the token position in the scan grid. For each finding, a gated attention module 30 with hidden size 512 scores every token, and a two-layer network with hidden size 384 and a GELU 65 assigns every token a logit. The attention scores are normalized over all tokens of the bag, and the study logit is the attention-weighted mean of the token logits with a per-finding scale and bias.
blocks.zh: 分类者将每次考试视为来自其所有观点(图5c和补充图4)的图像符号袋. 冰冻的区块-23标志通过可列车区块24及其最终层规范. 其产出与固定统计标准化,并在扫描网格中以24 Fourier特性64的象征位置扩展. 对于每一个发现,一个有门的注意模块30,每个隐藏大小512分,一个隐藏大小384的双层网络和一个GELU 65分配每个符号一个登录. 注意力的分数在包中的所有符号上实现常态化,研究日志是每个识别尺度和偏差的符号日志的注意力加权平均值.

blocks.en: Each finding was routed to its anatomical region. We derived 63 regions from CADS 66 organ segmentations, assigned a token to a region when the region covered at least 25% of the token, and defined the route of a finding as the union of the regions of the finding and its descendants. Tokens outside the route receive a learned penalty, the softplus of a per-finding parameter initialized at 5, subtracted from their attention score. A finding therefore attends mainly to its organs while every token remains available, and a view with fewer than eight tokens in the route is treated as entirely inside it. Thirty findings were left unrouted, including those whose organ may be displaced or absent, such as ectopic kidney.
blocks.zh: 每一个发现都经过解剖区域。 我们从CADS 66器官分裂中衍生出63个区域,给一个区域分配了一个象征物,而这个区域至少覆盖了象征物的25%,并将发现的路线定义为发现区域及其后代的结合. 路线外的托肯得到一个有学问的处罚,每个发现参数的软加在5时初始化,从他们的注意力分数中扣除. 因此,在每一个信物仍然可用时,调查结果主要涉及其机关,在路线中只有不到八个信物的视图则被视为完全在内。 30项调查结果没有按部就班地进行,包括器官可能流离失所或缺失的器官,如外科肾脏。

blocks.en: The classifier was trained with binary cross-entropy summed over the labelled findings and divided by the number of findings, without positive weighting, on one study bag per GPU and 128 bags per step, with token dropout of 0.2 and feature dropout of 0.1. Training ran in three stages of 38,740 steps in total as the routing table was refined, and at the start of the last stage the route penalty was reset to 1 for the 79 routed findings with fewer than 50 training positives. The final model is the checkpoint at the end of the last stage (epoch 4), with raw rather than exponential-moving-average weights. Per-finding Platt scaling 67 , fitted on training predictions and regularized towards the identity, converts logits into probabilities. The per-finding Youden 68 cut-off on training predictions is the decision threshold for classification metrics. Neither was refitted on validation or external data.
blocks.zh: 分类员接受了二进制交叉式的训练,在标注结果上进行了总结,除以结果数,每GPU一个学习袋和每步128个学习袋,象征性的退学率为0.2,特征退学率为0.1。 随着路线表的完善,培训共分为三个阶段,共38 740步,在最后阶段开始时,路线处罚被重新设定为79项路线检查结果的1项,培训结果不足50项。 最终的型号是最后一个阶段(时代4)末端的检查站,有原始而非指数移动的平均重量. 符合培训预测的每台Platt的尺寸为67, 并固定身份, 将日志转换为概率。 按调查的Youden 68对培训预测的截断是分类指标的决定阈值。 也没有根据审定或外部数据重报。

blocks.en: The signed evidence of a token for a finding is its attention-weighted contribution to the study logit. Evidence maps use its positive part, take the maximum over views in each cell of a world grid, are smoothed with a 4 mm Gaussian kernel and are restricted to the anatomical family of the finding, an organ, the lungs or lymph-node stations, when that family holds evidence. The smallest set of cells holding half of the smoothed evidence mass is split into connected components, and up to four of them, ranked by evidence mass, form the foci, each located at its mass-weighted centroid.
blocks.zh: 一个结论的标志的签名证据是它对研究记录的注意加权贡献。 证据地图发挥它的积极作用,在世界网格的每个细胞中取最大视线,用4毫米高斯内核平滑,在发现的解剖家族,器官,肺部或淋巴结站,当该家族持有证据时,仅限于解剖家族. 持有半个平滑证据质量的最小的一组细胞被分割成相连的组件,其中多达4个细胞按照证据质量排列,形成基物,每个基物位于其质量加权的中间体.

blocks.en: 4.6 Report generation
blocks.zh: 4.6 编写报告

blocks.en: For each examination, the report plan lists confident findings, with a calibrated probability of at least 0.5. It then includes possible findings at or above the training Youden cut-off, keeping the 20 with the highest calibrated probability. Each planned finding carries its calibrated probability relative to the training base rate, the distribution and sites of its evidence foci, located with the CADS segmentations, and an automated measurement where one exists. The writer is Gemma-4-31B-it 54 with LoRA 69 adapters of rank 16 and alpha 32 on the attention and feed-forward projections of its language model (Fig. 5 d ). It receives the instruction and the plan as one user turn without a system prompt, the study bag compressed to 512 latent tokens by a query resampler 70 together with study-type tokens, a pooled token and up to 16 focus tokens of evidence for each planned finding, and up to six zoomed evidence images per finding (Supplementary Figs. 2 a and 11 ). These are axial, coronal and sagittal views of the main site and axial views of up to three further sites, each encoded by the Gemma-4 vision tower and pooled to one token.
blocks.zh: 每次检查,报告计划都列出有把握的检查结果,校准概率至少为0.5. 然后包括培训Youden停产时或以上的可能发现,使20人保持最高的校准概率。 每项计划调查结果都带有与培训基数率、其证据基数的分布和地点(位于CADS区段)相比的校准概率,以及存在自动测量的概率。 编剧是Gemma-4-31B-it 54,其语言模型(图5 d.)的注意力和feed-forward预测上有LORA 69位16级和α 32级适配器. 它作为没有系统提示的用户一个转动而得到指示和计划,研究袋通过一个查询重印器70,加上研究类型的信使,集合信使和最多16个焦点信使为每个计划发现的证据,以及最多六个缩放的证据图像(补充图2 a和11 )压缩到512个潜在信使. 这些是轴线,冕线和斜线对主站点的看法,还有多达3个站点的轴线观点,每个站点都由Gemma-4视觉塔编码,并集合成一个标志.

blocks.en: The writer was trained to produce the Findings section of the reference report in two supervised stages, 4,666 steps over 295,541 training reports and a further 1,750 steps with the final plan tiers, followed by 300 steps of direct preference optimization 39 (Supplementary Fig. 2 b ). The vision tower, connector and LoRA adapters were trained in every stage. Preference optimization used the sigmoid loss on summed sequence log-probabilities with β \beta = 0.1, two pairs per study and the frozen second-stage writer as reference, together with a cross-entropy term on the preferred report. Pairs were drawn from a pool of 1,636,197 pairs from 290,033 training reports, of which about 72,000 were used. Each pair contrasted the reference with a version that omitted one or several findings, added a finding from the plan or at random, replaced abnormal statements with normal ones, repeated statements, changed an attribute such as side, size or severity, or asserted a finding that the reference explicitly denied. Reports were decoded by nucleus sampling 71 with temperature 0.8, top-p 0.9 and a per-study seed.
blocks.zh: 作者接受了培训,在两个监督阶段编写参考报告的结论部分,4 666个步骤超过295 541个训练报告,还有1 750个步骤与最后计划分级,随后是300个步骤直接优化偏好39(补充图2b)。 视觉塔,连接器和LORA适配器在每个阶段都接受了培训. 首选优化将sigmoid损失在汇总序列的对数概率上使用β\β=0.1,每研究两对和冷冻的第二阶段写作机作为参考,同时在首选报告上加一个交叉切入词. 从290,033份培训报告中抽取了1,636,197对,其中使用了约72,000对。 每一对都把引用与一个版本相对应,该版本省略了一个或几个结论,从计划中增加了一个结论,或随机地增加了一个结论,将异常语句替换为正常语句,重复语句,改变了像侧面,大小或严重性这样的属性,或者断言了该引用被明确否定的结论. 报告通过核取样71进行解码,其中温度为0.8,最高p 0.9和每研究一次的种子。

blocks.en: 4.7 Chest radiograph model
blocks.zh: 4.7 (中文(简体) ). 胸射线学模型

blocks.en: The chest radiograph model follows the same recipe. Its encoder was trained by the same self-distillation 72 , without the Gram-anchoring phase, on 272,183 radiographs of the training split, each treated as a two-slice volume at native resolution, for 30,000 steps, and block 24 was aligned with report statements for ten epochs. Labels came from the same three-pass extraction with a vocabulary of 311 findings (Supplementary Fig. 3 c ), and the 129 findings with at least 50 training positives became classifier targets. The classifier adds a learned view embedding for frontal, lateral and other films to the tokens before block 24 and uses no routing. It was trained on 257,595 studies from 173,864 patients, and 28,965 studies from 19,802 patients were held out by patient. The signed evidence of each finding is measured relative to its mean token level in the studies negative for the finding among 2,000 sampled training studies. The writer was trained by supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization and a second round of preference optimization on edited versions of its own reports, and reports were decoded greedily.
blocks.zh: 胸腔放射图模型遵循同样的配方. 其编码器由同样的自沉式72(没有格拉姆-安岭阶段)在272,183个训练分解的放射图上进行训练,每个分解器按原生分辨率作为双片卷,共30,000步,第24段与十个纪元的报告说明一致. 标签来自相同的三通提取,词汇为311个发现(补充图3c),至少50个培训阳性结果的129个结果成为分类目标. 分类器在第24项之前将一个嵌入正面,横向和其他影片的已学习到的视图添加到符号中,并且没有使用路由. 它接受了173,864名病人的257,595项研究的培训,19,802名病人的28,965项研究被病人进行。 每项调查结果的签名证据是按其平均象征性水平衡量的,对于2 000项抽样培训研究的调查结论来说是负数。 编剧通过监督的微调,优待优化和自身报告编辑版第二轮优待优化培训,报告被贪婪地解码.

blocks.en: 4.8 Comparison models
blocks.zh: 4.8 比较模型

blocks.en: We compared FORA with 18 released CT models, namely CoLiPri 17 , CT-CLIP, CT-Vocab and CT-LiPro 12 , fVLM 16 , Jolia 73 , Merlin 13 , Pillar-0 15 , RADAR 14 , EXACT 74 in its pretrained and fine-tuned versions, ClinFusion-8B and ClinFusion-32B 75 , NV-Reason-CT 21 , CT-CHAT 12 , Med3DVLM 76 , RadFM 9 and MedGemma 77 , and additionally with M3D 78 on the public benchmarks. All models were evaluated using their released weights, without retraining or probes. For contrastive models, we calculated the cosine margin between presence and absence prompts averaged over reconstructions, and used fixed prompt pairs for Merlin and Pillar-0. Generative models were given the longest series of each examination and were asked about each finding with their native prompt template (Supplementary Fig. 13 b ). Their decisions were the parsed yes or no answers, and ranking metrics used the next-token probability of yes or the margin between yes and no where the model exposed it. RADAR was scored with the released probability of each finding, averaged over reconstructions, and its native threshold of 0.5. We matched its 146 finding outputs to 202 of our 1,028 findings and to 9 of 18, 24 of 30 and 9 of 16 findings on CT-RATE, the Merlin test set and RAD-ChestCT, taking the highest probability when several outputs matched one finding and using its released protocol on the Merlin test set. Its released code does not process volumes with more than 1,000 voxels along an axis after resampling, which applied to 1,585 held-out examinations. Findings that a model cannot output and examinations that it cannot process were counted as negative decisions, so aggregate results reflect both coverage and performance.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了FORA与18个发布的CT模型,即CoLipri 17,CT-CLIP,CT-Vocab和CT-LiPro 12,fVLM 16,Jolia 73,Merlin 13,Pridge-0 15,RADAR 14,EXACT 74, 预训和微调版本的ClinFusion-8B和ClinFusion-32B 75,NV-Reason-CT 21,CT-CHAT 12,MD3DVLM 76,RadFM 9和MedGemma 77,另外在公共基准上与M3D 78. 所有模型都使用其释放的重量进行评估,没有再培训或探测器。 对于对比模型,我们计算出存在和缺位之间的余弦比值,平均比重建要快,并对Merlin和Pridge-0使用了固定的对速率. 基因模型是每次考试中时间最长的系列,并被问到每个发现时都有其本土的即时模板(补充图13 b )。 他们的决定是解析为是或否的答案,排名的衡量尺度使用了"是"或"是"和"否"之间的差值,而模型暴露在其中. RADAR的得分是每次发现的释放概率,平均超过重建,其本土阈值为0.5. 我们将其146项调查结果与我们1 028项调查结果中的202项结果和关于CT-RATE、Merlin试验套件和RAD-ChestCT的16项调查结果中的9项、18项、24项30项和9项相匹配,在几项结果与一项调查结果相匹配并利用其在Merlin试验套件上发布的协议时,其概率最高。 它的发布代码不会在复标后沿轴处理超过1000伏克赛尔的卷,这适用于1,585个停赛考试. 一个模型不能输出和不能处理的检查结果被算作否定决定,因此,综合结果既反映覆盖面,也反映业绩。

blocks.en: For report generation we compared the seven CT report generators whose released inference ran on our data, namely NV-Reason-CT, CT-CHAT 70B and 8B, Merlin, BTB3D 19 , Med3DVLM and RadFM, each with its authors’ prompt, decoding and token limit. We excluded MedGemma, which has no published CT report-generation prompt, ClinFusion, whose report protocol uses indications derived from the reference, CT-SSG, whose code is not released, EXACT-CHAT, whose checkpoint is incompatible with the released image export, and Astra, whose released inference failed on our data. For chest radiographs we compared seven classifiers (RadZero 40 , CARZero 44 , KAD 79 , MedKLIP 80 , BioViL-T 81 , GLoRIA 82 and MedGemma) and six report generators (LLaVA-Rad 83 , CheXagent 84 , Libra 85 , CXRMate 86 , RaDialog 87 and MedGemma).
blocks.zh: 对于报告生成,我们比较了七台CT报告生成器,其释放的推论来自我们的数据,即NV-Reason-CT、CT-CHAT 70B和8B、Merlin、BTB3D 19、Med3DVLM和RadFM, 以及作者的迅速、解码和符号限制。 我们排除了MedGemma,它没有出版的CT报告生成即时,ClinFusion,它的报告协议使用从参考文献中得出的指示,CT-SSG,它的代码没有发布,EXACT-CHAT,它的检查点与发布的图像导出不兼容,以及Astra,它的发布推断对我们的数据失败了. 就胸腔放射图而言,我们比较了7个分类器(RadZero 40、CARZero 44、KAD 79、MedKLIP 80、BioViL-T 81、GLORIA 82和MedGemma)和6个报告发电机(LLaVA-Rad 83、CheXagent 84、Libra 85、CXRMate 86、RaDialog 87和MedGemma)。

blocks.en: 4.9 Evaluation of finding recognition
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). 对发现识别的评价

blocks.en: We report AUROC, AUPRC, balanced accuracy and CRG 33 . Balanced accuracy and CRG use each model’s own operating point, the training Youden cut-off for FORA and the native decision rule for the other models. On the held-out set, AUROC, AUPRC, and balanced accuracy were averaged over all pairs of finding and examination type with at least 10 positive and 50 negative examinations (2,132 pairs covering 854 findings), and CRG pooled all decisions. Confidence intervals came from a first-order linearization of each metric with 200,000 patient-level multiplier draws 88 , and FORA was compared with each model by two-sided paired tests with Holm correction 89 across the 72 internal comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们报告AUROC、AUPRC、平衡准确和CRG 33。 平衡精度和CRG使用每个模型自己的操作点,FORA的训练Youden截断,以及其他模型的本土决定规则. 在搁置的一组中,AUROC、AUPRC和平衡的准确性平均分布在所有对有至少10次正考试和50次负考试的发现和考试类型上(2 132对包含854项结果),CRG汇集了所有决定。 置信间隔来自每公尺的一阶线性化,20万患者级乘积为88 ,FORA通过双侧配对测试与Holm校正89进行对比,共72个内部比较.

blocks.en: On the public benchmarks, each model was scored on the full finding set of the benchmark, 18 findings on CT-RATE 12 (1,564 studies from 1,304 patients), 30 on the Merlin test set 13 (all 5,125 test studies of its public release) and 16 on RAD-ChestCT 34 (3,630 scans). FORA used the same final checkpoint as on the held-out set without refitting, with its raw weights on the Merlin test set and RAD-ChestCT and its exponential-moving-average weights on CT-RATE (macro AUROC difference from the raw weights below 0.0001). For NV-Reason-CT on CT-RATE, the Results and Fig. 2 c give the macro AUROC of 0.871, where each volume is a separate input. Intervals came from 200,000 paired bootstrap draws, resampling patients on CT-RATE and studies on the other sets, with Holm correction across 186 comparisons. For renal cysts in KiTS23 36 (489 scans), rib fractures in RibFrac 35 (80 scans) and the 21 Merlin findings covered by RADAR’s released protocol, intervals came from 2,000 case-bootstrap resamples, and FORA was compared with the strongest alternative by a two-sided normal approximation with Holm correction across the three comparisons. Calibration of the Platt-scaled probabilities was assessed for findings with at least 10 validation positives, 900 for CT and 99 for chest radiographs, with reliability curves and the expected calibration error 90 over 15 equal-count bins (Supplementary Fig. 7 ). Subgroup analyses stratified the held-out set by age, sex, scanner manufacturer and tube voltage (Supplementary Fig. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 在公共基准上,每个模型都得分于该基准的整个发现集,18项CT-RATE 12(1,304名病人进行了1,564项研究),30项梅林测试13项(所有5,125项公开发布测试研究),16项RAD-ChestCT 34(3,630次扫描). FORA使用与停放装置相同的最终检查点,没有重新调整,其原始重量在Merlin测试装置和RAD-ChestCT上,其指数移动平均重量在CT-RATE上(AUROC与原始重量低于0.0001的差别)。 对于NV-Reason-CT上的CT-RATE,结果和图. 2c给出了0.871的宏AUROC,其中每卷是单独的输入. 间距来自20万对靴子图纸,在CT-RATE上对病人进行重新取样,并研究其他几套,Holm校正了186项比较。 对于KitS23 36(489次扫描)中的肾囊肿,RibFrac 35(80次扫描)中的肋骨断裂以及RADAR发布的协议覆盖的21个梅林发现,间隔来自2000个病例-波茨拉带复标,FORA通过两个侧面的正常近似与Holm在三个比较中校正来比较最强的替代品. 评估了至少10个验证阳性、900个CT和99个胸腔放射图的Platt尺度概率校准结果,并确定了可靠性曲线和预计校准误差90比15个等值的插件(补充图7)。 分组分析按年龄、性别、扫描仪制造商和管电压分类(补充图9)。

blocks.en: 4.10 Evaluation of localization
blocks.zh: 4.10 (中文(简体) ). 对本地化的评价

blocks.en: Localization used FORA’s evidence maps without any fitting to the annotations. The top-focus hit rate is the proportion of annotated instances for which the centroid of the highest-mass evidence focus lies inside the annotation. Evidence overlap is the proportion of instances whose annotation intersects the smallest set of 3 × \times 8 × \times 8 mm cells holding 50% or 80% of the smoothed evidence mass. Chance for the hit rate is the probability that a uniformly sampled token centre within the route of the finding lies inside the annotation. We used FUMPE 37 (35 scans, 33 with emboli), KiTS23 36 (489 scans with renal masses, 248 of them with cysts), RibFrac 35 (80 scans, 60 with fractures) and ReXGroundingCT 26 (414 CT-RATE validation studies with 1,139 evaluable instances in 11 categories). Intervals for the hit rate are exact binomial intervals 91 for FUMPE, KiTS23 and RibFrac. For ReXGroundingCT they come from 20,000 study-bootstrap resamples, and from 2,000 for the analysis by annotated volume.
blocks.zh: 本地化使用了FORA的证据地图,但没有与说明相适应。 头重心命中率是注释中最高质量证据焦点的百分位数在注释中的比例。 证据重叠是指在最小的一组3 ×\时 8 ×\时 8 mm 的单元格中,有50%或80%的平滑证据质量相交的情况。 对命中率来说,概率是发现路线内一个统一取样的标志中心位于注释内。 我们使用了FUPE 37(35个扫描,33个带emboli),Kits23 36(489个扫描带肾脏质量,248个带囊肿),RibFrac 35(80个扫描,60个带断裂)和REXGroundingCT 26(414个CT-RATE验证研究,11个类别中有1,139个可评价实例)。 FUMPE,KitS23和RibFrac的命中率间隔为精确的二元间隔91. 用于重置 CT来自2万个研究宝藏复刻本,还有2000个用于分析注解卷。

blocks.en: We compared these maps with RADAR and GLINT-CT 38 on every annotated target of the five settings, namely pulmonary emboli in FUMPE, renal cysts and renal masses in KiTS23, rib fractures in RibFrac and all 1,139 evaluable ReXGroundingCT findings, with lung nodules (305 instances in 211 studies) and pleural effusions (28 in 22) also shown on their own. A model without output for a target scored 0 on every measure for that target. RADAR was run with its released checkpoint and inference code. Its evidence was the attention map that RADAR provides as visual evidence for a finding, the weights of its organ query over the image tokens at three scales, taken from the forward pass that produces its released probability. The map belongs to the organ query, so the kidney map served renal cysts and masses, the rib map rib fractures and the lung map the three ReXGroundingCT categories covered by RADAR’s findings, lung nodule, lung opacity and pleural effusion, matched as in the classification comparison. RADAR has no prompt for pulmonary embolism or for the other eight ReXGroundingCT categories. The map was reduced to the 3 × \times 8 × \times 8 mm cells by the maximum per cell and scored with the code used for FORA. Because RADAR’s 80% evidence regions covered on average 36 to 212 times more cells than FORA’s, we compared evidence overlap at equal size, keeping for each instance as many of RADAR’s highest-valued cells as FORA’s 80% region contained and counting cells tied at the cut-off at their expected value.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些地图与RADAR和GLINT-CT 38比较了五个环境的每个附加说明的目标,即FUMPE的肺栓塞、KitS23的肾囊肿和肾块、RibFrac的肋骨断裂以及所有1,139个可评价的ReXGroundingCT发现,肺结核(211项研究中有305例)和胸膜充血(22项)也单独显示。 目标没有输出的模型在每一次测量中都得0分. RADAR被使用其发布的检查站和推断码. 其证据是RADAR为一项发现提供的视觉证据的注意图,其器官查询对图像符号的权重分量为三个尺度,取自产生其释放概率的前传. 该图属于器官查询,因此肾脏图服务于肾囊肿和质团,肋骨图断裂和肺部图,RADAR的发现覆盖的三个ReXGroundingCT类别,肺结核,肺不透明以及胸膜增生,与分类比较中相匹配. RADAR对于肺栓塞或者其他8个ReXGaturningCT类别没有迅速反应. 地图按每个单元格的最大值降为3×时8×时8×时8毫米的单元格,并按FORA使用的代码打分. 因为RADAR的80%证据区域平均比FORA的细胞多36到212倍,所以我们比较了证据重叠的大小相同,将RADAR的数值最高的细胞与FORA的80%区域一样多,并按预期值计算在断层上的细胞。

blocks.en: GLINT-CT was run with its released checkpoint. Its region was the part of its similarity map above the threshold that gave the best mean Dice on each set, chosen from 101 values between 0 and 1 as in its paper, and its first focus was the map-weighted centroid of the connected region with the largest summed map value. For overlap at equal size we used, for each instance, the highest threshold at which its region held at least as many cells as FORA’s 80% region. Paired differences used 1,000 bootstrap resamples of cases, or of studies for ReXGroundingCT, and the intervals of each model used 2,000.
blocks.zh: GLINT-CT被放行的检查站管理。 其区域是其高于阈值的类似地图的一部分,该地图在每套地图上给出了最优的平均值,如其纸上所示,从0至1之间的101个数值中选取,其第一个焦点是连接区域的地图加权百分点,其总和的地图价值最大。 对于相同规模的重叠,我们使用每个例子,其区域拥有至少与FORA80%区域相同的单元格的最高阈值。 Paired difference使用了1,000个靴子的病例复标,或用于ReXGroundingCT的研究,每个模型的间隔使用2,000个.

blocks.en: For chest radiographs, the evidence of the classes mapped to each annotation was combined with weights given by their probabilities, and the hit rate uses the peak of the highest-mass focus, counted inside any box of the finding and averaged over findings. The variant of the map was chosen on separate box-annotated development sets, the training split of ChestX-Det10 43 and the training and validation splits of PadChest-GR 46 . Test sets were the box-annotated subsets of ChestX-ray14 45 (880 images), ChestX-Det10 (459), RSNA Pneumonia 41 (1,218) and PadChest-GR (464).
blocks.zh: 对于胸腔放射图来说,绘制到每个注释的类的证据与其概率给出的权重相结合,命中率采用最高质量焦点的峰值,在任何发现框中计算,并平均于发现. 地图的变体选用在单独的盒式附加说明的开发集,ChestX-Det10 43的训练分裂和PadChest-GR 46的训练和验证分裂. 测试集是胸X射线14 45(880张图像),胸X-Det10(459张),RSNA肺炎41(1 218张)和PadChest-GR(464张)的盒状子集.

blocks.en: 4.11 Evaluation of report generation
blocks.zh: 4.11 联合国 评价报告的生成

blocks.en: Generated and reference Findings sections were labelled by the same three-pass Gemma-4-31B extractor with protocol-specific vocabularies (Supplementary Fig. 3 a,c ) and mapped to the 1,028 CT findings or the 129 chest radiograph findings. Asserted or uncertain findings counted as positive. Macro recall, precision and balanced accuracy were averaged over findings with at least 10 reference positives in each evaluated set, and CRG was pooled over the same findings. An LLM judge (Gemma-4-31B, Supplementary Fig. 13 a ) compared each generated report with the reference and counted matched findings and clinically significant errors of six kinds, namely missed findings, false findings, wrong location, wrong severity, false comparison and omitted comparison. The score of a report is the number of matched findings divided by the sum of matched findings and significant errors. A report with no matched finding scores 1 when it has no significant error and 0 otherwise. In the pairwise comparison, a separate prompt asked the judge to compare the reports of FORA and NV-Reason-CT with the reference in both presentation orders. Intervals came from 1,000 bootstrap resamples, clustered by patient on CT-RATE for the extractor metrics, and paired tests from 2,000 bootstrap resamples, clustered by patient on CT-RATE, with Holm correction within each figure panel.
blocks.zh: 生成的和参考的 " 调查结果 " 部分由同一三通Gemma-4-31B提取器贴上专有协议词汇(补充图3 a,c)的标签,并绘制成1 028个CT调查结果或129个胸腔放射图。 肯定或不确定的研究结果被认为是积极的。 总体回顾、精确度和均衡的准确度平均比调查结果高,每套评价中至少有10个参考阳性,而CRG是对相同结果的集合。 一名LLM法官(Gemma-4-31B,补充图13a)将每个生成的报告与参考文献进行比较,并计算出匹配的调查结果和临床上具有重大意义的六种错误,即误发现、误发现、误位、误重、误作比较和省略比较。 报告的分数是相匹配的调查结果数除以相匹配的调查结果和重大错误的总和。 一份没有匹配的发现分数 1 的报告,当它没有重大错误, 否则为 0 。 在对等比较中,一个单独的提示要求法官将FORA和NV-Reason-CT的报告与两个演示文稿命令中的参考进行比较。 间距来自1000个靴带复标,由患者在CT-RATE上为提取器的度量衡进行组合,再由2000个靴带复标进行配对测试,由患者在CT-RATE上组合,每个图面内都有霍尔姆校正.

blocks.en: The preference-optimization ablation compared, for CT, the first supervised writer with the same checkpoint after a separate DPO run of 375 steps that is not part of the released writer, on a fixed set of 500 validation studies. Both arms used greedy decoding, the first-stage plan and the training-label extractor, with micro-averaged metrics over findings with at least 10 reference positives. For chest radiographs it compared the supervised writer with the same writer after 200 DPO steps on all 28,965 validation studies. Within each comparison, plans and scoring were identical (Supplementary Fig. 12 ).
blocks.zh: 对CT来说,偏好优化比较了第一个拥有同一检查站的受监督的作家,这是在一次单独的DPO运行375步而不属于发行的作家之后,在一个固定的500套验证研究上. 两只手臂都使用了贪婪的解码,第一阶段计划和训练标签提取器,对至少10个参考阳性结果进行了微观平均测量。 在胸腔放射图方面,它将受监督的作家与同名作家进行比较,因为在所有28,965项验证研究中,有200个DPO步骤。 在每项比较中,计划和评分相同(补充图12)。

blocks.en: 4.12 Cohort and representation analyses
blocks.zh: 4.12 汇编和表述分析

blocks.en: The longitudinal analyses of Extended Data Fig. 5 use report labels only. For each patient and finding, the anchor was the first date with an asserted or uncertain label in a single examination type, and report states at the next dates of that type were compared, with reports on the same day combined by the precedence asserted, uncertain, denied and unmentioned.
blocks.zh: 扩展数据图5的纵向分析仅使用报告标签。 对于每个病人和发现者来说,主播是第一个在单一检查类型中贴有声称的或不确定的标签的日期,报告在下一个该类型日期作了比较,同日的报告与声称的、不确定的、否认的和未提及的优先性结合起来。

blocks.en: Profile groups were obtained from the 1,028 per-finding evidence values of FORA before its final affine layer. These were standardized and reduced to 50 principal components fitted on training studies, normalized to unit length and clustered by k-means 92 fitted on training studies (Extended Data Figs. 6 and 7 ). This gave 16 groups for the whole cohort, from 50,000 randomly sampled training studies, and six groups within each of six CT categories (head, neck, chest, cardiac, abdomen and spine). Enrichment of reported findings in each group was tested on the earliest examination of each patient, with two-sided Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel tests 93 stratified by CT category for the whole cohort and one-sided Fisher exact tests within categories, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction 94 .
blocks.zh: 从FORA的1 028个证据值中,在FORA的最后一个附属层之前,获得了概况组。 这些方案已经标准化,并减少到50个主要组成部分,用于培训研究,并按单位长度进行规范化,由培训研究的92千兆赫组合(扩展数据图6和7)。 这使整个组别有16个组别,从50 000个随机抽样的训练研究,以及六个CT类别(头部、颈部、胸部、心脏、腹部和脊椎)中的6个组别。 在对每个患者进行最早的检查时,对每组报告的检测结果进行了丰富度的测试,对整组患者进行了93次双侧Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel检测,按CT类别对整组患者进行了93次分级,对Fisher进行了分类中的单侧精确检测,Benjamini-Hochberg更正94。

blocks.en: For the tissue readouts, we averaged the frozen block-23 patch tokens of the image encoder over the tokens that the CADS segmentation assigns to an organ, using the soft-tissue window of the series with the most body tokens (Supplementary Fig. 15 ). Liver attenuation was read from the liver embedding, L1 trabecular attenuation and L3 muscle attenuation from the bone embedding, and aortic calcification from the abdominal-vessel embedding. Embeddings were normalized to unit length, standardized within each training fold and mapped to the measurement by ridge regression 95 with the penalty chosen among 13 values from 0.01 to 10,000. Five-fold cross-validation grouped by patient gave out-of-fold readouts for about 12,700 examinations of about 10,800 patients from both the training and the held-out sets. These examinations were recorded as non-contrast, with a median aortic blood attenuation below 70 HU and a median subcutaneous fat attenuation between − - 140 and − - 50 HU. Control readouts used age, sex and tube voltage, or the embedding of another organ. Intervals came from patient-cluster bootstrap resamples, 300 for the correlations with the measurements and 1,000 for the within-patient changes.
blocks.zh: 对于组织读取,我们平均将图像编码器的冷冻块-23补丁符号与CADS分区分配给一个器官的符号相比,使用该系列中含有最多身体符号的软组织窗口(补充图15). 从肝脏嵌入中读取肝脏衰减,从骨骼嵌入中读取L1 Trbecular衰减和L3肌肉衰减,从腹腔-血浆嵌入中读取主动钙化. 嵌入物已恢复正常为单位长度,在每套训练材料中标准化,并按脊回归95进行测量,从0.01到10 000的13个值中选择了罚分。 按病人分类的5倍交叉鉴定为大约12 700次检查提供了外读数,其中10 800名病人来自培训和停产。 这些检查被记录为非连续检查,主动脉血衰减中位数低于70HU,皮下脂肪衰减中位数在−-140--50HU之间。 控制读取使用年龄,性别和管电压,或者嵌入另一个器官. 间隙来自患者-组群的靴带复标,与测量结果的相关性为300个,患者内部变化为1 000个。

blocks.en: Repeat consistency was measured on held-out patients only (Supplementary Fig. 16 ). For each patient and CT category, the first two examinations on distinct days formed a pair, and each repeat was matched to 10 to 20 examinations of other held-out patients with the same examination type, site, contrast, scanner manufacturer and sex and an age within five years. Similarity was the cosine between unit-length finding profiles in the 50-component space, and intervals came from 1,000 patient bootstrap resamples. All tests were two-sided unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh: 仅对被扣留的病人衡量了重复一致性(补充图16)。 对于每个病人和CT类别,在不同的天数进行头两次检查形成一对检查,每一次重复检查对应10至20次对其他滞留的病人进行相同的检查类型、地点、对比、扫描仪制造商和性别以及五年内年龄的检查。 50个组件空间的单位长查找剖面的余弦是相似的,间隔来自1 000个病人靴子的复标。 除非另有说明,所有试验都是双面的。

blocks.en: Data availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en: The FORA dataset is not yet fully available. Researchers can request access at contact@forithmus.com . To support independent benchmarking, evaluation on the complete held-out FORA test set is available through https://research.forithmus.com/ . Researchers can submit their models as Docker containers for evaluation without downloading the underlying data. The chest radiograph dataset used to develop and evaluate the initial architecture is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Forithmus/FORA .

blocks.en: Code availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: The trained FORA models and code are publicly available at https://github.com/forithmus/FORA . FORA can also be accessed programmatically through an API at https://api.forithmus.com/ and explored interactively in Litera ( https://litera.forithmus.com/ ), an imaging workspace for viewing examinations, reviewing AI-generated report drafts and inspecting the spatial evidence behind individual findings.
blocks.zh: 训练有素的FORA模型和代码可在https://github.com/forithmus/FORA上公开查阅。 . FORA也可以通过API(https://api.forithmus.com/)在程序上访问,并在Litera(https://litera.forithmus.com/)进行互动探索,这是一个用于观看检查的成像工作空间,审查AI生成的报告草稿,并检查个别调查结果背后的空间证据。

blocks.en: List of supplementaryfigures 15 Continuous tissue information in FORA features. a–d , Measured liver attenuation, L1 bone attenuation, aortic calcification and L3 muscle attenuation against out-of-fold readouts. e–h , Within-patient changes between two scans. i , Error of target-organ, other-organ and demographic readouts. j , Correlation of measured and readout changes. k–n , Bland–Altman agreement. blocks.en: List of supplementaryfigures 16 Consistency of CT profiles across repeat examinations. a , Similarity of each examination to the same patient’s repeat (blue) and to matched other patients (grey). b , Repeat advantage by CT category. c , Repeat similarity by interval. d , Group retention by interval. e , Repeat advantage for same and changed site, contrast or manufacturer. f,g , Group assignment of repeat (f) and reference (g) examinations, groups as in Extended Data Fig. 6 .
